en: A commemorative postcard with a graphic illustration of a soldier sitting and raising one arm, rendered in blue on a light grey patterned background. Above the figure are the years "1918–1920"; below, in bold letters, is the phrase "EESTI VABADUSSÕDA". Small cross-like badges appear in the four corners around the main image. The design evokes a memorial to the Estonian War of Independence.
